USCG NOTMAR 57803
A) USCG
E) Chandeleur Sound - Rocket Launching Activities --- From: 2026-11-09 To: 2026-11-24 --- Two suborbital rocket launching operations will be conducted off a vessel in Chandeleur Sound in approximate position 29-55-45N 089-03-46W.  Operations will be weather dependent and will take place from 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.  Two short-range rockets will be launched on separate days to demonstrate sea-based launch-pad
capabilities.  Each launch is expected to last several minutes from ignition through splashdown, with a
maximum potential downrange distance of approximately 1,070 meters (0.6 nautical mile).  On-scene vessels will include the M/V ONCE IN A LIFETIME and the F/V SOUTHERN CROSS.  Mariners are requested to maintain a 500 yard closest point of approach from the operating area.  VHF-FM Channel: 16, 18 and 72,  POC: (228) 669-3644
